Private Jet Crashes in Florida, Killing Nine Aboard

A private jet traveling from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas crashed on Sunday, November 1, in Palm Beach County, Florida, killing all nine people on board. Dramatic footage captured the aircraft plunging from the sky before exploding on impact near a roadway. The crash occurred about 11 kilometers away from former President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence, though he had departed the area an hour prior. The aircraft was identified as a Learjet.
